title: Thai Gooey Egg Casserole
description: A Thai-inspired twist on the classic egg casserole, with gooey cheese and savory spices.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Add casserole mix and cook according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, and feta cheese. Add cooked casserole mix to the bowl and stir.
Pour egg mixture into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top with shredded cheese and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until set and golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
